lesson_name: Where in the world are tropical rainforests?

photos.subject: A real wide aerial photograph of intact Amazon rainforest canopy in the Amazon basin
photos.pedagogical_constraint: The frame must show a broad, continuous canopy in the Amazon basin, not a generic jungle close-up and not an area dominated by recent clearing.
photos.teaching_requirement: Provide authentic evidence for the Amazon's dense vegetation and immense forest cover.
load_bearing_evidence: a wide area of dense closed tree canopy
the photograph is reliably identified as being in the Amazon basin
no dominant road, plantation, large cleared field or urban skyline
enough landscape context to show scale rather than one tree
photos.fallback_note: A generated forest could not serve as evidence for what the real Amazon rainforest looks like.
coherent_visual_invariants: each image is a real photograph reliably located in the Amazon basin
wide landscape framing preserves geographical context
the load-bearing feature remains clear when three sources are shown together
no added labels, arrows, watermarks or text inside the image

photos.subject: A real wide photograph of a major Amazon River channel or large tributary running through rainforest
photos.pedagogical_constraint: The waterway must appear broad and be surrounded mainly by Amazon rainforest, with a reliable Amazon-basin location.
photos.teaching_requirement: Provide authentic evidence that enormous rivers are a major physical feature of the Amazon rainforest.
load_bearing_evidence: a wide river channel large enough to dominate the landscape
dense rainforest on one or both banks
the photograph is reliably identified as being in the Amazon basin
a broad view that shows the relationship between river and forest
photos.fallback_note: A generated river scene could not serve as evidence for the scale and appearance of a real Amazon waterway.
coherent_visual_invariants: each image is a real photograph reliably located in the Amazon basin
wide landscape framing preserves geographical context
the load-bearing feature remains clear when three sources are shown together
no added labels, arrows, watermarks or text inside the image

photos.subject: A real riverside settlement or city in the Amazon basin with buildings and boats visible beside the water
photos.pedagogical_constraint: The frame must clearly show human presence within an Amazon-basin landscape without presenting the whole region as either untouched forest or one vast city.
photos.teaching_requirement: Counter a single-jungle lens by showing that people live and travel in the Amazon rainforest region.
load_bearing_evidence: several clearly visible buildings
boats, a landing place or another visible sign of river travel
a broad river or forested riverbank in the same frame
the photograph is reliably identified as an Amazon-basin settlement or city
photos.fallback_note: A generated settlement would invent evidence about how and where real people live in the Amazon basin.
coherent_visual_invariants: each image is a real photograph reliably located in the Amazon basin
wide landscape framing preserves geographical context
the load-bearing feature remains clear when three sources are shown together
no added labels, arrows, watermarks or text inside the image

photos.subject: A fresh real aerial photograph of an Amazon river winding through dense rainforest
photos.pedagogical_constraint: The river and continuous forest must both remain distinct in a worksheet-sized crop, and the source must reliably identify the Amazon-basin location.
photos.teaching_requirement: Give the worksheet fresh visual evidence for dense vegetation, extensive forest cover and large waterways.
load_bearing_evidence: a clearly visible winding or branching river
dense green forest covering most of the frame
a wide aerial perspective that shows scale
the photograph is reliably identified as being in the Amazon basin
photos.fallback_note: A generated aerial scene could not provide truthful fresh evidence about the real Amazon landscape.
coherent_visual_invariants: each image is a real photograph reliably located in the Amazon basin
near-square or landscape crops remain legible on one A4 page
the two sources show different attributes of the place
no added labels, arrows, watermarks or text inside the image

photos.subject: A fresh real photograph of the Manaus riverfront or another documented Amazon-basin city beside a broad river
photos.pedagogical_constraint: Buildings, boats or port activity and the broad river must all remain clear in a worksheet-sized crop; the location must be reliably documented.
photos.teaching_requirement: Give the worksheet fresh evidence that the Amazon rainforest region includes major waterways and places where people live and travel.
load_bearing_evidence: a broad river occupying a substantial part of the frame
several buildings or a recognisable urban riverfront
boats, port structures or another visible sign of river travel
a reliable Manaus or Amazon-basin location
photos.fallback_note: A generated city scene would invent evidence about a real named place in the Amazon basin.
coherent_visual_invariants: each image is a real photograph reliably located in the Amazon basin
near-square or landscape crops remain legible on one A4 page
the two sources show different attributes of the place
no added labels, arrows, watermarks or text inside the image

photos.subject: A real published world map showing the global distribution of tropical rainforest
photos.pedagogical_constraint: The map must use recognisable real-world geography and clearly show tropical rainforest distribution across Central and South America, Africa, Asia and Oceania; it must not be a schematic coastline drawn from guessed coordinates.
photos.teaching_requirement: Provide truthful geographical evidence for where tropical rainforests occur, used consistently across slides 6, 7 and 8 alongside the real map helper's Equator and Tropics.
load_bearing_evidence: recognisable world geography from a published map source
tropical rainforest distribution visible across Central and South America, Africa, Asia and Oceania
a clear key or unambiguous single-category shading
sufficient resolution for a full-width classroom slide
photos.fallback_note: If no reliable published map can be sourced, record a gap; do not invent rainforest regions on the real base map.
coherent_visual_invariants: each image is a real published thematic map
world geography remains recognisable and undistorted
the key and distribution remain legible at classroom scale
no generated or hand-drawn coastlines

photos.subject: A real published world biome map with a clear key
photos.pedagogical_constraint: The map must use recognisable real-world geography and distinguish tropical rainforest, desert, savannah or grassland, temperate forest, boreal forest and tundra with a clear consistent key.
photos.teaching_requirement: Provide the accurate world biome map used consistently across slides 4, 5, 13 and 15.
load_bearing_evidence: recognisable world geography from a published map source
six required biome categories visible or clearly reconcilable to the lesson vocabulary
a legible key with colours used consistently on the map
sufficient resolution for a full-width classroom slide
photos.fallback_note: If no reliable published map can be sourced, record a gap; do not invent biome regions on the real base map.
coherent_visual_invariants: each image is a real published thematic map
world geography remains recognisable and undistorted
the key and distribution remain legible at classroom scale
no generated or hand-drawn coastlines
